sloka: अद्य रामम् ससुग्रीवम् परिघेण सलक्ष्मणम् ।आगमिष्यामि हत्वा एको विक्षोभ्य हरि वाहिनीम् ॥६-८-११॥।।
transliteration: adya rāmam sasugrīvam parigheṇa salakṣmaṇam ।āgamiṣyāmi hatvā eko vikṣobhya hari vāhinīm ॥6-8-11॥।।

translations.english: "Now I would go alone and with the iron crowbar, kill Sugriva Lakshmana and Rama and return after shattering the Vanara troops."
